summary: Added pending jobs section to provider dashboard. Jobs display in same layout as services (card-based grid). Shows first 2 pending jobs with service name, client name, date/time, price, and status badge. Clicking a job card navigates to alljobs.php detail page with job ID parameter. Implemented URL parameter handling in alljobs.js to automatically show job detail when job ID is in URL. Added pages_alljobs.js script to provider dashboard to access booking data.
current_status: Pending jobs feature implemented on provider dashboard. Jobs display in services-style layout, clickable to view details. URL parameter handling added for direct navigation to job details. Ready for testing.
